paragraphs: Pixel Apps is an independent software studio committed to designing intuitive and accessible applications for the modern desktop. We believe that interacting with advanced artificial intelligence should feel natural, responsive, and genuinely empowering for everyday computer users.

AI Chatbot is our sleek, native macOS companion engineered to bring frontier AI models from OpenAI, Google Gemini, and xAI Grok straight to your desktop. With a lightweight footprint, distraction-free design, and native keyboard shortcuts, Pixel Apps gives Mac users an intelligent partner they can rely on throughout their day.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI Chatbot, model integrations, macOS compatibility, and subscriptions

items.question: What AI services are integrated into AI Chatbot?
items.answer: AI Chatbot integrates multiple third-party AI services including OpenAI, Google Gemini, and xAI Grok through their public APIs, providing diverse intelligence engines in one desktop app.

items.question: Is AI Chatbot an official app from OpenAI, Google, or xAI?
items.answer: No. This macOS application is independently developed by Pixel Apps and is not an official app of OpenAI, Google, or xAI. It is not endorsed, sponsored, or affiliated with any of these companies.

items.question: Is the application lightweight and optimized for macOS?
items.answer: Yes. AI Chatbot is built natively for macOS with a minimal memory footprint, full Apple Silicon and Intel optimization, smooth performance, and native dark mode support.

items.question: How do keyboard shortcuts work in AI Chatbot?
items.answer: The app includes intuitive macOS keyboard shortcuts allowing you to summon the assistant, create new chat threads, navigate history, and copy responses without lifting your hands from the keyboard.

items.question: Can I manage multiple chat threads and review my history?
items.answer: Yes. You can create separate conversation threads for distinct topics, projects, or creative brainstorms, with complete searchable history saved locally on your Mac.

items.question: How do subscriptions and billing work?
items.answer: AI Chatbot offers auto-renewing subscriptions for unlimited premium access. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase confirmation, and subscriptions can be managed or canceled anytime in your Mac App Store account settings.

blocks.text: The Service Provider does not independently store this information on its own servers unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Such information is processed for the purpose of providing the requested functionality. Processing, storage, and retention by third-party providers are governed by their respective privacy policies and terms.

If you contact the Service Provider directly, for example by email, information contained in your communication may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your request, maintain appropriate business records, comply with legal obligations, or resolve disputes.

If you have contacted us directly or believe that we possess personal information relating to you, you may contact us at amir.support@icloud.com to request information or deletion, where applicable.
Information processed independently by third-party service providers may be subject to the deletion procedures and policies of those providers.

If you are a parent or legal guardian and believe that a child has provided personal information directly to the Service Provider, please contact us at amir.support@icloud.com, and we will take appropriate steps to address the request.
Users must meet the minimum age requirements applicable in their country or obtain any required consent from a parent or legal guardian.
Security
The Service Provider takes reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect information associated with the Application.
However, because certain Application features may communicate with third-party services over the internet, no electronic transmission or processing method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Third-party service providers are responsible for protecting information processed through their respective systems in accordance with their own security practices and privacy policies.
Your Choices
You may stop using the Application at any time by uninstalling it from your device.
You may also choose not to use features that require information to be transmitted to third-party services.
Where applicable, device permissions can be managed through your device’s operating system settings.
Disclosure Required by Law

The Service Provider may disclose information in its possession if required to do so by applicable law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or when reasonably necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of the Service Provider, its users, or others.

Any updated Privacy Policy will be made available through the Application or the location where this Privacy Policy is published. The effective date shown at the top of this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.
